question: This may not be the time to worry about such things, but aside from Rem and Katya, are there any people from the Kingdom or Empire whom Subaru corresponds with by letter?
answer:
Considering how hectic things have been since they returned, it would actually be quite difficult for them to keep up with correspondence. But thinking in terms of the setting, Tanza should be exchanging letters with Subaru. Medium should also be corresponding with Emilia and Subaru. And since Flop is diligent about writing letters, I imagine he's probably been doing so as well. So, as you can probably tell, I think the members of Vollachia who actually have good communication skills have been sending letters, and their interactions have continued. (Laughs)

As for Abel, he's bound to send letters that are properly formatted, as if they were written by an AI(Artificial Intelligence). But they do correspond with each other, and I think that will continue in the future as well.
